blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) enables language models to improve text-to-image (T2I) generation by rewriting prompts for a frozen image generator. Existing methods typically apply a single signal derived from the image to individual subword tokens, although objects, counts, attributes, and relations form coherent semantic spans. We propose SCOPE, an objective based on Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) that aligns update weighting with this structure. The rewriter jointly generates an enhanced prompt and its semantic partition. SCOPE pools shifts in policy log probabilities within each span to derive a shared coefficient for its token losses while retaining a single advantage for each completion. It requires neither separate span rewards nor additional image renders. Across Qwen-Image, SD3, and FLUX.1-dev, SCOPE achieves average relative gains over vanilla GRPO of 9.48% on GeneVal and 7.62% on T2I-CompBench. Ablation studies show that both semantic boundaries and pooling within spans contribute to these gains, supporting semantic structure as a practical inductive bias for prompt engineering with RL.
blocks.zh: 强化学习(RL)使语言模型能够通过重写被冻结的图像生成器的提示来改进文本到图像(T2I)生成. 现有方法通常将从图像得到的单一信号应用到单个子词符上,尽管对象,计数,属性,关系组成了连贯的语义跨度. 我们提出SCOPE,这是一个基于集团相对政策优化(GPRO)的目标,它使更新的权重与这一结构保持一致. 重写器联合生成一个增强的快取及其语义分区. SCOPE 集合在每个范围内政策日志概率的变化,以得出其象征性损失的共享系数,同时为每次完成保留单一优势。 它既不需要单独的跨度奖励,也不需要增加形象。 在Quen-Image、SD3和FLUX.1-dev中,SCOPE在GeneVal和T2I-Comp Bench上的平均相对增益分别为9.48%和7.62%。 语义研究显示,语义界限和跨度内的集合都有助于这些收益,支持语义结构作为用RL进行即时工程的一种实际的诱导偏差.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Text-to-image (T2I) generation models [ 15 , 34 , 42 , 36 , 8 , 60 , 55 , 54 , 41 , 40 , 43 , 6 , 16 ] turn language into visual content, with prompts serving as the primary interface for controlling generation. Small wording changes can determine whether an image preserves object counts, binds colors correctly, or places objects in the intended spatial relation. As diffusion and flow generators grow larger, retraining or lightly adapting the visual decoder is often expensive and risks image quality [ 26 , 29 , 11 , 30 , 20 , 38 , 39 , 1 , 7 , 5 , 12 ] . Prompt adaptation offers a cheaper alternative by improving the language interface while keeping the image generator fixed.
blocks.zh: 文本对映(T2I)生成模式[15,34,42,36,8,60,55,54,41,40,43,6,16] 将语言转化为视觉内容,由提示作为控制生成的主要界面. 小的措辞变化可以决定一个图像是保存对象计数,正确绑定颜色,还是将对象置于预定的空间关系. 随着扩散和流动发电机的增大,再培训或轻度调整视觉解码器往往费用昂贵,并危及图像质量[26、29、11、30、20、38、39、1、7、5、12]。 通过改进语言界面,同时保持图像生成器的固定,即时改编提供了一个更便宜的替代品.

blocks.en: Prompt optimization with a frozen generator can be formulated as a reinforcement learning problem. A language policy rewrites the input prompt, the T2I model renders an image, and an evaluator assigns a scalar reward based on the requested composition. Recent methods [ 15 , 34 , 55 ] exploit this feedback loop to improve T2I alignment while keeping the visual backbone fixed. GRPO converts rewards from grouped rewrites into an advantage for each completion without requiring a learned critic [ 46 , 28 ] . The objective applies this advantage across token positions without accounting for semantic span boundaries.
blocks.zh: 使用冷冻发电机的快速优化可以被制定为强化学习问题. 语言策略重写输入提示, T2I 模型生成一个图像, 评估者根据请求的构成分配一个刻度奖励 。 最近的方法[15,34,55]利用这个反馈循环来改进T2I对齐,同时保持视觉主干线的固定. GRPO将分组重写中的奖励转换为每次完成的优势,而不需要一个有学识的批评家[46,28]. 目标在不考虑语义跨度界限的情况下,将这一优势应用于象征性位置。

blocks.en: Compositional prompt edits to objects, attributes, counts, spatial relations, and scene context form coherent phrases that can span several subword tokens. Tokenizer boundaries reflect subword segmentation and need not coincide with these semantic units. An object description can combine an identity, a count, and an attribute, while a relation phrase links multiple objects. Words expressing each edit jointly specify a compositional constraint, even across multiple subword units. The image reward evaluates the resulting composition holistically, without direct attribution to constituent spans or tokens. This exposes a fundamental credit assignment bottleneck: uniform token-level updates fragment coherent compositional edits across arbitrary subword boundaries, yet estimating dense per-span rewards incurs prohibitive rendering overhead.
blocks.zh: 组成性即时编辑对象,属性,计数,空间关系,和场景上下文组成了连贯的短语,可以跨越多个子词符号. Tokenizer 边界反映了子词分割,不需要与这些语义单元重合. 一个对象描述可以结合一个身份,一个计数,和一个属性,而一个关系短语可以链接多个对象. 表达每次编辑的单词共同指定一个组成约束,甚至跨多个子词单位. 图像奖励从整体上评价由此产生的构成,而不直接归属于构成周期或象征。 这暴露了一个基本的信用任务瓶颈:统一符号级更新将连贯的构成编辑从任意的子字界限中分离出来,但估计密集的每平方英尺的回报会造成令人望而却步的翻版。

To bridge this gap, we introduce S emantic Bounded C redit O ptimization for P rompt E ngineering ( SCOPE ), a GRPO-compatible objective that modulates token updates across semantic spans. The rewriter outputs a prompt rewrite and its semantic partition, mapped onto rollout tokens. SCOPE pools shifts in token log probabilities between the current and old policies within each span to derive a detached coefficient. This coefficient reweights the contribution of the shared advantage to each token loss in the clipped GRPO surrogate. The objective retains a loss for each valid token and a single advantage for each completion. SCOPE uses the existing rendering and reward pipeline, without separate rewards or advantages for individual spans, additional image renders, or a learned critic.
Moreover, SCOPE serves as a strict generalization of standard GRPO, seamlessly recovering uniform token updates when span modulation is neutralized ( β = 0 \beta=0 ).

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: GRPO [ 46 ] optimizes autoregressive policies without a learned critic and shares an advantage across tokens in each completion. Recent work [ 37 , 22 , 48 , 35 , 44 , 9 , 51 , 25 ] explores finer credit assignment through eligibility traces, counterfactual evaluation, and estimation over tree structures. Segment Policy Optimization (SPO) [ 14 ] partitions reasoning trajectories into segments and estimates distinct advantages for individual segments. This gives credit estimates a granularity between individual tokens and complete trajectories. FIPO [ 33 ] uses discounted future policy divergence to reweight token updates according to subsequent trajectory behavior. Our SCOPE retains a single advantage for each completion. Its contribution to token updates is modulated by shared within each semantic span, derived by pooling the policy log-probability shifts between the current and previous policies.
blocks.zh: GRPO [46] 在没有学问的批评者的情况下优化了自旋政策,并在每次完成时共享一个跨符的优势. 最近的工作[37、22、48、35、44、9、51、25]通过资格追踪、反事实评价和对树木结构的估计,探索更细的信贷分配。 片段政策优化(SPO)[14]将推理轨迹分割成片段,并估算单个片段的明显优势. 这使得信用估计在单个信物和完整的轨迹之间具有颗粒性. FIPO [33] 使用折扣后的未来政策差异来根据后续的轨迹行为重新加权符号更新. 我们的SCOPE对每次完成都保持单一优势. 它对符号更新的贡献通过在每个语义段内共享来调制,通过将当前和以往政策之间的政策日志概率变化汇集在一起来得出。

blocks.en: Prompt optimization adapts the textual input to elicit desired outputs from a pretrained T2I generator. Prior work [ 34 , 42 , 36 , 8 , 57 , 23 , 56 , 21 , 24 , 27 , 47 , 19 ] explores search and iterative refinement strategies for improving generation quality or consistency between text and images. Learned prompt adaptation trains language models to transform user inputs into prompts that the generator prefers. Promptist [ 15 ] combines supervised initialization with RL driven by image rewards. PAG uses GFlowNets to promote effective and diverse prompt adaptation, while RePrompt uses GRPO and signals for image preference, alignment, and composition to train a rewriter augmented with reasoning [ 61 , 55 , 50 ] . Our SCOPE addresses the optimization objective within this setting. It incorporates the semantic structure of compositional edits into token weighting while retaining a shared advantage for the complete rewrite.
blocks.zh: 即时优化可以调整文字输入,从预先训练的T2I生成器中引出期望的输出. 之前的工作[34,42,36,8,57,23,56,21,24,27,47,19]探索搜索和迭代完善策略,以提高生成质量或文本与图像的一致性. 学会了即时适应训练语言模型,将用户输入转化为生成器喜欢的提示. 快速器 [15] 结合了受监督的初始化和由图像奖励驱动的RL. PAG使用GFlowNets来促进有效和多样的即时适应,而RePrompt则使用GRPO和信号进行图像偏好,对齐,和组成来训练一个经过推理扩充的重写机[61,55,50]. 我们的SCOPE处理在这个背景下的优化目标。 它将成分编辑的语义结构融入到符号加权中,同时为完全重写保留共同优势.

blocks.en: Reinforcement learning optimizes visual generators by treating image synthesis as a sequential decision process. Prior work [ 2 , 49 , 52 ] optimizes diffusion trajectories through policy gradients driven by image rewards or through preference optimization. Flow-GRPO [ 28 , 32 , 10 , 45 ] optimizes denoising trajectories of flow models, while Mask-GRPO [ 31 ] treats iterative masked generation as a policy with multiple steps. B 2 -DiffuRL [ 17 ] addresses sparse reward credit assignment within diffusion trajectories through backward progressive training and sampling over branches. Our SCOPE optimizes the prompt rewriting policy through image feedback while keeping the renderer frozen.
blocks.zh: 强化学习通过将图像合成作为顺序决定过程来优化视觉生成器. 前作[2,49,52]通过由图像奖励驱动的政策梯度或通过偏好优化,优化传播轨迹. Flow-GRPO [28, 32, 10, 45] 优化了流模式的去诺化轨迹,而Mask-GRPO [31] 则将迭代蒙面一代视为有多个步骤的政策. B 2-DiffuRL [17]通过落后的渐进式培训和在分支上取样,解决传播轨迹中鲜有的奖励信贷分配问题。 我们的SCOPE通过图像反馈优化了快速重写策略,同时保持渲染器的冻结.

T2I-CompBench covers attribute binding, object relationships, and complex composition.

blocks.en: GenEval. SCOPE achieves the highest overall GenEval score across all three frozen backbones (Table 1 ), boosting overall performance over vanilla GRPO from 0.91 0.91 to 0.95 0.95 on Qwen-Image ( + 4.4 % +4.4\% relative), 0.74 0.74 to 0.84 0.84 on SD3 ( + 13.5 % +13.5\% relative), and 0.76 0.76 to 0.84 0.84 on FLUX.1-dev ( + 10.5 % +10.5\% relative). Across the three backbones, SCOPE achieves strict improvements over GRPO in 17 17 out of 18 18 category benchmarks while maintaining near-saturated color accuracy on Qwen-Image ( 0.93 0.93 ), trading a marginal 0.01 0.01 fluctuation for substantial gains in complex spatial positioning ( + 0.08 +0.08 ) and attribute binding ( + 0.08 +0.08 ). Moreover, the most pronounced improvements appear in object counting and spatial positioning, two persistent bottlenecks for frozen T2I generators. On SD3, SCOPE substantially outperforms GRPO in both Counting ( 0.58 → 0.79 0.58\rightarrow 0.79 , + 36.2 % +36.2\% ) and Position ( 0.57 → 0.83 0.57\rightarrow 0.83 , + 45.6 % +45.6\% ). On FLUX.1-dev, SCOPE lifts Counting by + 0.11 +0.11 and raises Position accuracy from the unadapted baseline of 0.16 0.16 and GRPO’s 0.62 0.62 to 0.84 0.84 , representing a more than 5 × 5\times gain over the base generator. These improvements also extend to multi-object synthesis and attribute binding, achieving 0.99 0.99 two-object accuracy and 0.88 0.88 attribute binding accuracy on Qwen-Image.

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation and Mechanistic Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 分析和机制分析

blocks.en: Effect of credit weighting. Figure 3 (a) compares SCOPE’s span-pooled weighting against uniform GRPO and unpooled token-level likelihood shifts. Crucially, applying likelihood shifts at individual tokens degrades performance below standard GRPO across all backbones. This confirms our core hypothesis: unpooled token-level modulation injects high-variance subword noise that disrupts coherent multi-token phrases, whereas pooling shifts within semantic spans stabilizes credit allocation. Furthermore, a Token local shift control, which retains semantic boundaries while applying uniform GRPO updates, yields only 0.90 0.90 , 0.75 0.75 , and 0.76 0.76 across backbones compared to 0.95 0.95 , 0.84 0.84 , and 0.84 0.84 for SCOPE. Thus, explicit credit modulation across spans (as opposed to merely structured formatting) drives the performance gain.
blocks.zh: 信用加权的效果。 图3(a)比较了SCOPE的跨池加权数与统一的GRPO和未组合的符号级概率变化。 关键是,在所有骨干部门,采用单个标志上的可能性变化会降低低于标准GRPO的业绩。 这证实了我们的核心假设:未集合的符号级调制注入高变量的子词噪声,干扰了连贯的多键短语,而语义跨度内的调制则稳定了信用分配. 此外,Token本地转向控制在采用统一的GRPO更新的同时保留语义边界,主干线上只输出0.90 0.90、0.75 0.75和0.76 0.76,而SCOPE则输出0.95 0.95、0.84 0.84和0.84 0.84。 因此,跨时期的明确信用调值(而不是仅仅结构化的格式)推动了业绩收益。

blocks.en: Effect of span boundaries. In Figure 3 (b), replacing semantic partitions with random boundaries ( 0.86 0.86 ) or fixed 3 3 -token windows ( 0.87 0.87 ) causes a severe 8 ​ – ​ 9 % 8\text{--}9\% drop relative to SCOPE ( 0.95 0.95 ) on Qwen-Image. Arbitrary groupings sever coherent compositional phrases across window borders, proving that linguistic boundary alignment, rather than generic multi-token smoothing, which is essential for effective credit assignment.
blocks.zh: 跨边界的影响。 在图3(b)中,将语义分区替换为随机边界(0.86 0.86)或固定的3 3 -托肯窗口(0.87 0.87)导致在Quen-Image上相对于SCPE(0.95 0.95)的重度8–9% 8\text{-}9\%的下降. 任意的组合将连贯的构成词断开,跨越窗口边界,证明语言边界一致,而不是通用的多键平滑,这对于有效的信贷分配至关重要。

blocks.en: Effect of the advantage rule. Figure 3 (c) evaluates SCOPE under three completion-level advantage estimators on FLUX.1-dev: pure baseline subtraction ( Δ ​ b g \Delta b_{g} , 0.827 0.827 ), standard group normalization ( z z -norm, 0.832 0.832 ), and our hybrid threshold rule ( 0.841 0.841 ). First, all three variants substantially outperform uniform GRPO ( 0.760 0.760 ), confirming that SCOPE’s gains stem fundamentally from semantic span modulation. Second, the hybrid rule yields an additional + 0.009 +0.009 boost by anchoring updates to the original prompt when initial quality is low ( b g < τ b_{g}<\tau ) and switching to fine-grained group discrimination once generation competence is established.

With the original prompt, the frozen Qwen-Image places the cup beneath the couch, draws five
handbags instead of four, and renders an ordinary orange. GRPO still misses the layout, the

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We present SCOPE , a semantic-aware credit optimization framework for RL-based prompt engineering with frozen text-to-image generators. By pooling policy log-probability shifts within coherent semantic spans to modulate a shared completion advantage, SCOPE resolves subword credit fragmentation while requiring no separate span rewards, additional image renders, or external parsers. Across Qwen-Image, SD3, and FLUX.1-dev, SCOPE achieves substantial improvements over vanilla GRPO, delivering average relative gains of 9.48 % 9.48\% on GenEval and 7.62 % 7.62\% on T2I-CompBench. Accordingly, SCOPE establishes structure-aligned credit assignment as a plug-and-play paradigm for unlocking the compositional potential of frozen visual generators.
blocks.zh: 我们提出 SCOPE,一个语义意识的信用优化框架,用于基于RL的即时工程,使用冷冻的文本到图像生成器. 通过集合政策日志概率在连贯的语义跨度内转换以调和共享的完成优势,SCOPE解决了子词信用分散,同时不需要单独的跨度奖励,额外图像生成,或者外部解析器. 在整个Quen-Image、SD3和FLUX.1-dev中,SCOPE比香草GRPO取得了显著改善,在GenEval和T2I-CompBench上的平均相对收益分别为9.48%和7.62%。 因此,SCOPE将结构一致的信用分配确定为释放冷冻视觉发电机构成潜力的插件和游戏范式。
